question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**variety**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the diverse wildlife found in the savanna.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the presence of different species of animals.
 
• "**Variety**" fits well as it denotes a range of different animals in the savanna.
 
• Other options ("**array**", "**peak**", "**mixture**") do not appropriately describe the diversity of wildlife in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Array (सरणी): While "array" can mean a collection, it is more commonly used for organized or structured arrangements, which is not the best fit here.
 
• Peak (चोटी): "Peak" means the highest point, which does not fit the context of describing different animals.
 
• Mixture (मिश्रण): "Mixture" refers to combining different elements but does not specifically imply different species.
